title: Color effect: advanced type drops alpha channel (alphaMult hardcoded to 256, alphaAdd missing)
description: In packages/swf/src/cxform.ts, the 'advanced' color effect branch hardcodes alphaMult=256 and alphaAdd=0 (lines ~110, 114), silently dropping any alpha multiplier or alpha offset from the color effect. When a symbol instance has an advanced color effect with both color and alpha components changed, the alpha channel is lost. Fix: (1) add alphaOffset field to the Advanced type in model/types.ts (or wherever ColorEffect is defined), (2) in flash8-import.ts, map the binary aOff value to alphaOffset, (3) in cxform.ts, use the actual alphaMult and alphaAdd from the effect model instead of hardcoded values.
